input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen (flagship 7) photo-editing: BUILDABLE HERE 'next: the auto fallback' for --demosaic noise-aware

errors.what: First real-raw run at 4 processes in parallel: a worker was OOM-killed (signal 9) on 36 MP frames and xargs stopped after 6 rows
errors.fix: Reran 2 at a time with a per-file wrapper; peak memory added to each row and reported as a finding (up to 6.4 GB on 36 MP)

errors.what: Raws read directly have no colour matrix, so develop() refuses them without a .dcp
errors.fix: The check tool injects the sRGB XYZ->RGB matrix as a stand-in (colour only; demosaic and noise reading unaffected), stated in the eval note

doc_friction.issue: Says PY=$(python3 platform/ci/pyenv.py pytest numpy) finds an interpreter; here it printed /usr/bin/python3.13 while bare python3 lacked numpy, so the first tool run failed until python3.13 was used explicitly

deviations.why: The default demosaic (auto) was not switched to noise-aware even though held-out quality allows it: the real-frame check showed 5.8x directional's time and up to 6.4 GB on 36 MP
deviations.did: Made frame noise the default only inside --demosaic noise-aware (the flagship item), left auto as directional, and recorded cost-cutting as the next item
deviations.result: Shipped; no behaviour change for users who do not ask for noise-aware

notes: Verification: python3.13 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py photo-editing -> ok (182.8s, 1292 tests, 9 skipped), 0 failed. tests/test_demosaic_noise_aware.py 21 passed after the change. Real-frame check (tools/noise_fallback_real.py) on 60 public sample raws: 53 develop, all 52 without a NoiseProfile used the frame model, 0 fell back; Nexus 5X DNG kept its profile. Post front-matter, links and similarity checks clean. No separate docs/reports agent doc: the eval note and NEXT.md carry what the next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
